notes.title: Scutter | Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the release of Scutter!  We hope you have as much fun playing it as we had making it.  There are still many new features to come so please help us make it great.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32922155/3c54e84b463e18b7eebd1b7f7a13b23a3cce0244.jpg[/img]
